title: Candidate authored tile recipe v2
description: Typed future controls are preserved exactly; all candidate v2 recipes remain unresolved in A/B. Graph evaluation, width/section/stair/graded providers and live adoption are unimplemented.

field.description: General finite values remain supported for non-checkerboards. Under zero-positive classification, ambiguous masks 5/10 require exactly [1,-1,1,-1] or [-1,1,-1,1]; unequal magnitudes and zero-valued checkerboards are unsupported and must not be normalized.
